subject: SIG / SOC 2 evidence: admin activity export packaging and delivery
messages:
From: Taelor Morris <taelor.morris@acmehealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-07T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: SIG/SOC2 admin activity export (Oct 1–31 2026)

Hi Markus / Laura,

We are finalising the SIG and SOC 2 evidence package for our auditors and need a copy of Redwood's admin activity logs covering Oct 1–31, 2026 for the Acme Health tenancy. Specifically our auditors asked for:

- All admin/operator events (console and API): role changes, admin logins, 2FA changes, API key creation/revocation, user provisioning/deprovisioning, permission grants/revokes, integration token lifecycle, model deploy/rollback events.
- Timestamps in UTC, actor identity (user id/email), affected resource, opaque request id, and any associated request payload metadata (size / agent).
- Export format preferences (ndjson preferred), compressed archive, and a checksum (MD5 or SHA256).
- Proof of delivery / chain-of-custody statement for the snapshot.

Please confirm whether Redwood can produce a bundled snapshot for that date range and outline the delivery options (S3 presigned URL, encrypted transfer, or Hub download). We can provide an auditor contact (audit@ledgershield.com) and a PO number if needed.

Thanks,

Taelor Morris
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Acme Health
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Taelor Morris <taelor.morris@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com], Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-07T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SIG/SOC2 admin activity export (Oct 1–31 2026)

Taelor — thanks for the clear ask. We can provide the admin activity evidence you describe; below is a concise summary of what we log, retention defaults, and the available packaging/delivery options. Once you confirm date range, delivery target, and whether you require pseudonymisation, Ben will prepare an export.

What we log (operator/admin activity):
- Authentication events: successful/failed admin console logins, SSO assertions, MFA changes.
- Privilege management: role/permission grants and revocations, group membership changes.
- Credential lifecycle: API key / service token create/rotate/revoke, KMS key usage markers.
- Configuration & provisioning: tenant settings changes, model publish/rollback, dedicated pool allocations, VPC/peering changes.
- Billing & quota admin events: invoice adjustments, quota exceptions, reserved capacity assignments.
- System operator actions: manual job restarts, emergency failover triggers, node decommission events.

Retention & scopes:
- Default retention for hosted customers: 13 months (rolling).
- Enterprise/Dedicated or Private deployments: configurable up to 36 months on request and documented via the support contract.
- Snapshots we produce are strictly time-bound extracts (UTC) and include an export manifest describing record counts and schema.

Export formats and packaging:
- Formats: ndjson (line-delimited JSON), gzipped jsonl, or Parquet (columnar) for large exports.
- Schemas: we include a machine-readable manifest + schema.json describing fields and event types.
- Packaging: single compressed archive (tar.gz) containing shards (by day) for large ranges; each shard includes a per-shard SHA256.
- Chain-of-custody: we supply a signed manifest (PEM signature) and a delivery statement including export job id, operator id, and timestamp.

Delivery options:
- Customer S3: upload into customer bucket (cross-account) using a short-lived upload role (recommended for retention of chain).
- Redwoods presigned S3 URLs: time-limited GETs (recommended for one-off transfers).
- Secure HTTPS transfer to an Acme endpoint with mutual TLS (mTLS) if you provide endpoint details and certificates.
- GDrive/Drive link via restricted share for convenience (not preferred for auditor ingestion).

Security & redaction options:
- Pseudonymisation: we can hash or redact selectable fields (email -> hashed id) and provide a separate mapping under NDA only if expressly requested.
- KMS: exports are encrypted with our platform key by default; we can optionally encrypt with your KMS key (provide ARN) for delivery to S3.

Next steps we need from you:
1) Confirm final date range (Oct 1–31, 2026 looks good).
2) Delivery preference: S3 cross-account upload / presigned URL / mTLS endpoint.
3) KMS requirement: provide customer-managed KMS ARN or accept Redwood-encrypted output.
4) Pseudonymisation requirement (yes/no).
5) Auditor contact for verification (audit@ledgershield.com provided).

I attached a short CSV summarising export options and defaults (admin_activity_export_options_20261207.csv). Once you confirm, Ben will schedule the job and we’ll provide an ETA and signed manifest.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Product Security, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-07T11:22:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: SIG/SOC2 admin activity export (Oct 1–31 2026)

Ben — Taelor from Acme asked for the Oct snapshot. Markus confirmed we can provide it and outlined the options. Can you pick this up and coordinate with infra to:

- Generate ndjson shards for 2026-10-01 through 2026-10-31 (UTC), gzip each shard.
- Produce a signed manifest + per-shard SHA256s and a job-level SHA256.
- If customer provides KMS ARN, encrypt the final tarball with their key; otherwise use platform key.
- Upload to Acme cross-account S3 bucket if they provide the bucket ARN, otherwise produce presigned GET links.

Please respond with an ETA and add the proof-of-delivery artifact to the related hub record (HD-7392). Mark as high priority; the PO may arrive shortly (procurements@acmehealth.com).

Thanks,
Laura
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Taelor Morris <taelor.morris@acmehealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-09T15:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SIG/SOC2 admin activity export (Oct 1–31 2026)

Thanks Markus / Laura / Ben — that plan works for us. A few clarifications: 

- PO: 4938 attached (PO_4938.pdf).
- Delivery: preferred via cross-account S3 upload to arn:aws:s3:::acme-health-audit-uploads (we will send bucket policy and upload role shortly).
- KMS: please use our customer KMS (ARN will be provided in a follow-up secure note).
- Checksums: include SHA256 per shard and a job-level SHA256 in the signed manifest. MD5 also helpful for quick checks.
- Auditor: audit@ledgershield.com — they may reach out to validate the signed manifest.

ETA requested: can you confirm if the export and upload can be completed by EOD 2026-12-10? We understand there may be an internal job queue; if you need extra time, please advise.

Taelor Morris
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Acme Health
